nodes.label: Folder Icon Template (folder.svg)
nodes.rationale: 128x128 folder icon (back panel with tab, edge strip, gradient front face) whose colors are $placeholders instead of literals, so the app can substitute per-folder colors at runtime to generate recolored folder icons.

nodes.label: Folder Color Placeholders ($highlight, $color, $back, $edge)
nodes.rationale: string.Template-style substitution variables: $highlight->$color form the front-face vertical gradient, $back fills the rear panel, $edge fills the lip between back and face. Keeps one SVG shape as the single source for every folder color variant.
